EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S1.title: Define External Link Schema and Contract
EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S1.description: Define and standardize the external link schema to include site_name, url, label, guidance_text, source_type (official|review|license), and display_order. Ensure guidance text clearly explains how to interpret each source (NPI Registry = official data, Healthgrades = consumer reviews, state boards = license verification) and aligns with provider_detail_service output structure.

EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S2.title: Implement External Link Construction Logic
EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S2.description: Implement deterministic link construction using NPI and state from provider data. Ensure correct URL patterns for NPI Registry, Healthgrades search/profile, and supported state medical boards (DE, MS, VA). If Healthgrades profile is not resolvable, fallback to search URL using provider name + location. If state-specific board links are unavailable, omit the link.

EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S3.title: Expose External Links via EvaluateCare Facade and UI Rendering
EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include validated external links in the provider detail response. Render links in the frontend as labeled items with tooltip guidance_text and external-link indicators, ensuring clarity and safe navigation. All links must open in a new tab with rel="noopener noreferrer" and pass through existing markdown sanitization pipeline.

EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S4.title: Unit and Integration Tests for External Links
EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S4.description: Implement unit tests for schema validation and link construction, plus integration tests validating end-to-end flow from provider_detail_service through facade to frontend-ready payload. Include cases for missing NPI, unsupported states, invalid URLs, and fallback behavior.

EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S5.title: Integrate URL Validation for External Links
EVAL-PROVIDER-LINKS-S5.description: Pass all constructed links through url_guardian for validation, sanitization, and correction (HEAD check, AI verification, fallback). Ensure invalid or unreachable links are either corrected or excluded before reaching the facade.
